ui.realTime: Live simulation time, not a request to shut down or trigger an alarm.
ui.pause: Pause the solar simulation; do not imply that the native Windows shutdown is paused.
timer.stopAlarm: Stop alarm audio, not shut down the computer.
timer.shutdownScheduled: Display only after the existing native success acknowledgement; preserve {time}.
timer.shutdownUnknown: Result unconfirmed: the PC may still be scheduled to shut down. Do not translate as cancelled or failed with certainty.
timer.shutdownCancelled: Native cancellation confirmed, not merely clicking the switch.
timer.shutdownFailed: Windows returned a failure code; preserve {code}.
timer.timerTarget: Show the target clock time and the remaining duration. Preserve both {time} and {remaining}.
timer.helperDownloadPrivacy: Describe only the existing one-time receipt data. Do not claim that native helper installation is required for ordinary alarms.
timer.shutdownDataWarning: A safety warning to save work because Windows timed shutdown can close applications forcibly.
ui.auNote: Optional astronomical-unit footnote. An intentionally empty value is valid for the languages already using it.
